name: Total War: Warhammer III - Tides of Torment
summary:
The Tides of Torment DLC pack introduces three new Legendary Lords for the High Elves, Slaanesh, and Norsca, playable in Immortal Empires and Custom Battles.
Each Legendary Lord brings unique campaign mechanics, features, and battlefield units inspired by Warhammer lore. Whatever your style – aggressive, decadent, or manipulative – none can escape the Tides of Torment!
